reviews.question: al-Faqih's statement of the compiler's routes («طرق») to a source, with no saying: unruled

reasons.claim: The compiler's route runs from his father through Sa'd and Ahmad to al-Hassan and Durust, five links in order as both readers give.
reasons.quote: رويته عن أبي- رحمه اللّه- عن سعد بن عبد اللّه، عن أحمد بن محمّد بن عيسى

reasons.claim: The fourth link is written without «بن» and is kept as written.
The structure is right if such route statements are stored as chains; if the owner rules they are not chains, the item would become no_chain.
reasons.quote: و ما كان فيه عن درست

reasons.claim: The chain runs Ahmad b. Sulayman, Ubayd Allah, Isra'il, Simak, al-Nu'man b. Salim, then an unnamed man.
reasons.quote: قال عبيد الله حدثنا إسرائيل، عن سماك، عن النعمان بن سالم، عن رجل، حدثه

reasons.claim: «نحوه» at the end is a wording note with no transmitters of its own.
Six links from al-Darimi to Abu Dharr, the gloss on Marwan left out.
reasons.quote: حدثنا مروان، - يعني ابن محمد الدمشقي - حدثنا سعيد بن عبد العزيز

reasons.claim: Sa'id's closing remark describes Abu Idris and adds no route.
reasons.quote: قال سعيد كان أبو إدريس الخولاني إذا حدث

reasons.claim: The chain ends at Abu Sa'id, whose words follow.
reasons.quote: أنه سمع أبا سعيد الخدري، يقول

reasons.claim: Ismail names Iyad as his informant.
reasons.quote: قال أخبرني عياض بن عبد الله بن سعد بن أبي سرح

reasons.claim: Ibn Jurayj relays from Ata' al-Khurasani from Ibn Abbas, the last link.
reasons.quote: حدثنا ابن جريج، قال قال عطاء الخراساني عن ابن عباس

reasons.claim: The chain runs to Abu Salama and then Aisha, the last link the stored chain lacks.
reasons.quote: قال حدثني أبو سلمة بن عبد الرحمن، قال حدثتني عائشة

reasons.claim: Two co-transmitters at the first level joined by «قالا».
reasons.quote: وابن، بشار قالا حدثنا محمد بن جعفر

reasons.claim: Mansur and al-A'mash both heard Sa'd, a second co-transmitter level, giving four routes.
reasons.quote: والأعمش، أنهما سمعا سعد بن عبيدة

reasons.claim: The only named source is the Imam after «عن», who speaks the saying; the compiler names no transmitter between.
reasons.quote: وَ فِي حَدِيثٍ آخَرَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ

reviews.uncertainty_note: A one-link chain from an unspecified other report could also be treated as having no isnad.

reasons.claim: Jamil, Zurara, then the Imam who answers.
reasons.quote: وَ رَوَى جَمِيلٌ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ

reasons.claim: Abu Bakr found the report in his book from Abu Usama; the book is no link.
reasons.quote: قال وجدت في كتابي عن أبي أسامة

reasons.claim: Hisham, his father, then Aisha whose words follow.
reasons.quote: عن هشام، عن أبيه، عن عائشة، قالت
